privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How PrimeDesk collects, uses, and protects your information.
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information PrimeDesk Business Solutions ("PrimeDesk", "we", "us") collects through primedeskgroup.com, how we use it, and the choices you have. We're a marketing studio based in Houston, Texas.

blocks.text: Information you give us. When you fill in our contact form, we collect your name, your email address and/or phone number, the services you're interested in, and anything you tell us about your goals. If you email or call us, we receive whatever you choose to share.
Information collected automatically. Like most websites, our hosting provider records basic technical information when you visit, such as your browser type, device and the pages you view.

items: To reply to your enquiry and talk with you about working together
To keep a record of our conversations with prospective and current clients
To understand how our website is used and improve it

blocks.text: We don't use your information for anything unrelated to these purposes, and we don't sell it.

We share information only with service providers that help us run the website and our business, such as our website host (Vercel), our form service (Formspree) and our email provider (Google Workspace). These providers may only use your information to provide their service to us.
We may also share information if required by law, or to protect our rights.
Our website does not use cookies for tracking or advertising.

We keep enquiry information for as long as we need it to follow up with you, or for as long as we work together, and then delete it unless we need to keep it for legal or accounting reasons. You can ask us to delete it at any time.
You can ask us to see, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you by emailing fareed.huda@primedeskgroup.com. We'll respond as soon as we reasonably can.
Our website and services are for businesses and are not directed at children under 13. We don't knowingly collect information from them.
We may update this policy from time to time. When we do, we'll change the "Last updated" date at the top of this page.
Questions about this policy? Email fareed.huda@primedeskgroup.com or call +1 (832) 819-8366.
PrimeDesk Business Solutions, Houston, Texas
